title: Te Poropiti o ngā Maunga Whakairo
intro: I ngā koraha uaua o Arapia onamata, i puta mai tētahi āhua i roto i te iwi rongonui mō ā rātou mahi toi whakamiharo. I tū ō rātou kāinga i te toka totoka, engari he pakeke ake ō rātou ngākau i ngā maunga i keria e rātou. I tae mai tētahi karere atua me tētahi tohu whakamiharo kotahi - engari ko te whakapehapeha me te whakakeke i arahi ki ngā hua tere me te whakamataku. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i te pononga rangatira i whiriwhiria e tōna iwi te whakangaromanga i te arataki?
clues: I tonoa ahau hei kaiwhakatūpato ki tōku iwi, hei karanga i a rātou ki te karakia ki te Atua Kotahi.
I noho tōku iwi i waenganui i ngā toka whakamiharo, i whakairo i ngā whare whakahīhī ki ngā taha o ngā maunga.
I taku inoi, i puta mai tētahi kamera uha merekara i roto i te toka totoka, he tohu mārama tēnei nā te Kaha Rawa.
I mea atu ahau ki tōku iwi kia tohaina te wai ki tēnei kamera uwha, kaua hoki e tukinotia.
I whakatakoto whakaaro taku iwi mō te kamera uwha, ā, i whakapotoa e rātou ōna uaua, hei hiri i tō rātou ake whakangaromanga.
I pā mai te rū whenua nui ki tōku iwi, ā, i mahue iho rātou, kāhore he nekehanga i roto i ō rātou kāinga.

Te hanga i tētahi āka nui i waenganui i te tawai

Te maka ki roto i te ahi mura
Te takahi i te kawenata o te Hāpati
trial.answer: Te whakawhāiti i te uaua o te kamera uha whakamiharo

location.label: He aha te huānga matua?
options: He kamera uwha i puta mai i te toka
He āaka rakau nui

He tohorā nui whakaharahara
He maunga e iri ana i runga ake
location.answer: He kamera uwha i puta mai i te toka

outcome.label: He aha te mutunga iho?

I toremi i roto i te waipuke nui
I hurihia ō rātou pā e te whakahau a te Atua
I tahuna e te hau werawera
Horomia e te whenua
outcome.answer: He rū whenua ohorere i te rangi

arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَثَمُودُ
verse: And if they deny you, [O Muḥammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd deny [their prophets], (22:42)
